currentRoundInspection.method: Reference picture pixels inspected; standard viewer PMTiles used for approximate location, orientation and terrain fit.
currentRoundInspection.placement: The inspected aerial picture supports the open court, copper helmets, steep dark roofs, stepped gables and bounded island defenses. Retained east/south map coordinates with heading0 set approximate footprint and western approach. Standard viewer PMTiles supply surrounding terrain; reconstructed court floorY4.7 is above coarse ground and the island/pier toes reach the same sampler at every level. Broad water simulation and terrain cutouts are excluded. Anchor 16.355425549,56.657997261; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 6.099512477948403m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.
